sources.title: Retrieval Grounding Study 1
sources.body: Study 1 explains that retrieval grounding selects durable wiki evidence before Raw fallback. It also connects retrieval grounding with citation provenance, so repeated sources should compound into shared concept pages rather than isolated summaries.
